E0411

Unknown `pub(…)` visibility qualifier — only `pub(package)` exists (D-PUBPKG1)

What

Unknown `pub(…)` visibility qualifier — only `pub(package)` exists (D-PUBPKG1)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0411

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0411: tests/ui/pub_package_bad_qualifier.stderr.

Error [E0411]: unknown `pub(…)` qualifier — only `pub(package)` is supported
  --> tests/ui/pub_package_bad_qualifier.jet:1:5
    |
  1 | pub(crate) fn helper() {
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: `pub(package)` restricts access to sibling packages in the same payload
 Fix: write `pub` (public to all) or `pub(package)` (package-scoped)
